data.body: Added a '## Acceptance Criteria' checklist (6 items, derived from this epic's own description) to clear the P1 readiness-shape deterministic floor — done under operator authorization while investigating gate latency (bug 1e88-687f-45d1-435f), NOT as a claim of ownership of this epic's plan. Review it as a normal plan-review candidate. Incidental review feedback from those runs: the deterministic floor still flags P6 ac-quality (the term 'properly' is vague; no verification commands referenced) and an advisory that live children carry undeclared file_impact (drift-scope inheritance poisoned). A full agentic review under both Bedrock and Anthropic returned BLOCK; see bug 1e88 for the per-pass latency data.
